item.title: Bharat Electronics among 5 stocks showing White Marubozu pattern
item.description: Five Nifty 50 stocks featured in the White Marubozu bullish scanner on November 4, after gaining over 3%. Bharat Electronics led the list, followed by Adani Enterprises, Titan Company, Jio Financial Services and Max Healthcare.

item.title: Diwali Dhamaka stocks for portfolio: 10 shares with up to 34% upside potential ICICI Direct is bullish on
item.description: For the festive season, ICICI Direct has identified ten promising stocks that could be wise investments, boasting notable potential for growth. Among these are Venus Pipes and Tubes and Kotak Mahindra Bank. Each stock has specific buying ranges and target prices. Investors should assess their portfolios carefully, especially given the current market fluctuations.

item.title: Adani Enterprises among 4 Nifty 50 stocks showing bullish RSI upswing
item.description: Four Nifty 50 stocks featured in the RSI Trending Up scan on November 4, indicating improving price momentum. Jio Financial Services, Mahindra & Mahindra, Bajaj Finserv and Adani Enterprises recorded RSI readings above 50.

item.title: Cracker stocks this Diwali! Axis Direct selects 12 technical stock with 48% upside potential for Samvat 2083
item.description: Aurobindo Pharma, Hindustan Aeronautics, and IOL Chemicals demonstrate solid growth prospects for the coming year. Similarly, Jyoti CNC Automation and Karnataka Bank are expected to experience significant gains according to their long-term performance charts. Noteworthy mentions also include Dr. Lal Path Labs, Mayur Uniquoters, and Shivalik Bimetal Controls, all showcasing attractive target prices.

item.title: HEG Advanced Materials among 3 stocks closing above VWAP
